scope: Finish the restart-safe H0.0 scaffold on current canonical main by selectively transferring the reviewed R2 implementation capability, keeping all R1/R2 execution ledgers historical-only, and proving phase-independent Git-only recovery before any runtime branch creation.
required_outputs: Phase-independent active Work Order evidence/review isolation
Fresh Evidence Map and post-build critique
Independent Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS
stop_conditions: Any gameplay/runtime/domain path would need to change
Any canonical harness schema or checkpoint contract would need to change
Any historical R1/R2 execution record would need to enter or mutate in the R3 tree
Current main moves away from the epoch base before checkpoint proposal unless an exact referenced NON_RED epoch audit authorizes descendant-main continuation
PC0 has an unresolved blocking RED
A blocking Human Attention decision is required
risk_reasons: The scaffold reconstructs authorization state from Git-only immutable evidence.
Incorrect Work Order partitioning could reuse stale historical PASS evidence.
The refresh must preserve current-main registry/control semantics while transferring only proven H0 implementation capability.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.0 R2 was correctly invalidated when main advanced from 40c117bb to registry generation 67 at 9ad18eab before final verification. The reviewed implementation fixes must be retained without allowing R2 execution evidence to authorize a fresh epoch.
design_brief.current_behavior: Current main contains the canonical registry/control baseline but not the executable H0 scaffold. Historical R2 contains a reviewed implementation head 905f0d7d with phase-independent evidence isolation and narrowed implementation freshness, plus a terminal stale execution ledger that must not be reused.
design_brief.desired_behavior: R3 starts from exact current main, contains only the executable H0 implementation/test/validation capability plus a new R3 execution ledger, reconstructs state without chat, keeps C22 runtime blocked, and requires fresh R3 evidence for every checkpoint predicate.
alternatives_considered: Merge the terminal R2 branch and keep its execution ledger active.
Selectively transfer only the reviewed implementation capability into a fresh current-main R3 tree and create a new epoch/work order.
design_brief.selected_design: Use current main 9ad18eab as first-parent base. Use R2 implementation head 905f0d7d only as capability provenance/transport, delete the entire R2 execution subtree before creating R3 state, rewrite epoch-specific launcher/tests to R3, and re-prove all H0.0 predicates.
design_brief.why_selected: This preserves exact epoch freshness, prevents stale PASS reuse, retains proven fixes, minimizes net diff, and keeps runtime work fail-closed until H0_0_SCAFFOLD_READY.
expected_risks: Accidentally retaining an R2 epoch-specific path in executable code or tests
Historical execution evidence entering the R3 active tree
A repair review being mistaken for final checkpoint authorization
Main moving again before evidence freeze
validation_plan: Require main..R3 net diff to contain only allowed H0 control/harness paths and no R1/R2 execution subtree.
Run phase-independent unit tests on exact R3 checkout.
Run Status, Plan and Resume from the exact R3 checkout and a clean clone.
Prove malformed/stale historical review/evidence claims fail closed before active Work Order filtering.
Run standard and directional PC0 and require NON_RED.
Require fresh exact-head Evidence Map, final Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS before checkpoint proposal.
